subject: Next steps & evaluation kickoff - scheduling technical kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery - proposal for eval kickoff

Hi Sara (and Tom),

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today - really appreciated the clarity on your retrieval use case and SLAs. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You want to validate Redwood's ability to (1) serve sub-100ms 1-token latency on top-line queries, (2) maintain answer accuracy on your internal policy prompt set, and (3) support on-prem/private deployment for the PII flows.
- Success criteria (draft): 80% pass rate on the policy prompt set, end-to-end latency under 300ms p95 for the retrieval path, and a validated data-handling plan for PII.

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (45-60 min) to align the trial plan, confirm prompt sets/evals, and schedule a technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer. My suggested times (PT):
- Tue, Sep 14 - 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00
- Wed, Sep 15 - 10:00-11:00

Can you confirm which works for you? I can loop in Connor from SE to own the tech part. I attached a short evaluation plan draft (ACME-eval-plan-v1.pdf) that outlines phases, sample tests, and responsibilities.

If you prefer, share a calendar invite for a preferred slot and we'll accept. Also: if there are any security/SSO requirements to prep ahead of the kickoff (SAML, company IP allowlist, sample data access), please flag them so we bring the right folks.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this underway.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: ACME-eval-plan-v1.pdf
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.com>

Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - proposal for eval kickoff

Thanks Marissa - great write-up and aligned with what we discussed.

Both Tom and I can make a 60-minute kickoff. Our preference is Wed, Sep 15 at 10:00 PT, but we could also do Tue 14 at 14:00 if needed.

A couple of notes ahead of the kickoff:
- Success criteria look right; we'll share a prioritized prompt set (policy & customer-facing QA) before the call.
- We do have SSO (Okta) and an IP allowlist requirement; happy to share network ranges and a point of contact from our infra team.
- Also want to confirm whether the eval will run on Redwood Hosted or a Private deployment for the trial - we may need a limited Private sandbox for PII-sensitive prompts.

Please go ahead and book Wed 9/15 10:00 PT if that works for you and include Connor for the technical deep-dive. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Sara
Sara Patel
Head of AI Products | Acme Corp

Hi Sara - thanks for the context, and happy to take the tech portion on 9/15. A few items I'll plan to cover and a short checklist that would speed the kickoff:

Tech checklist for kickoff prep:
- Access: sample prompt set (CSV) and 10-20 representative user queries
- Data: example documents (anonymized) or pointers to the retrieval store schema
- Network: IP ranges to pre-authorize (if Private sandbox)
- Auth: Okta SAML metadata (IdP entity, ACS URL) or a test service account for Hosted eval
- Metrics: any pre-existing evaluation scripts or scoring rubric you use for policy tests

I attached a short inference checklist to show what we'll validate during the trial (inference-checklist.xlsx). If you can drop the prompt set and any sample docs into a shared Drive link, I will pre-run a couple of baseline queries so we have numbers to discuss.

See you on 9/15.
Connor O'Brien
